title: God: Powerful Even if Nonexistent?
excerpt: We might say that whatever our God is like, whether or not our God exists, our God is still powerful because our image of God transforms us. – The Great Spiritual Migration (available NOW, 2016) Tour info here: /archive
body:
We might say that whatever our God is like, whether or not our God exists, our God is still powerful because our image of God transforms us.
